label: Simulator instrumentation validation: pages and button recovery
working_tree: Uncommitted codex/runtime-telemetry, schema 2; not approved release evidence
scenario: thermal-climb recording; seven page types held 60 virtual seconds each; menu visit; held RIGHT button with 10/20ms loop stalls
coverage_notes: Actual firmware scheduler and display render paths under host HAL. All seven page contexts and interaction exclusions asserted. No radio/hardware-driver performance measurement.
limitations: Integration-test executable, not an operational workload. Host CPU is uncalibrated. Simulated stalls check scheduling progress and accounting, not physical sensor or flight-data correctness.
